---
title: "Live-birth 80/20 split: train vs validation distribution check"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
```


```{r compare}
df_lb_train <- readr::read_rds("data/models/df_lb_train.rds")
df_lb_val   <- readr::read_rds("data/models/df_lb_val.rds")

lb_split_compare <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  df_lb_train %>% mutate(val_flag = "train"),
  df_lb_val   %>% mutate(val_flag = "val")
) %>%
  group_by(val_flag) %>%
  summarize(
    n          = n(),
    event_rate = round(mean(birth_bool, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    mean_age   = round(mean(age_model, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd_age     = round(sd(age_model,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    q10_age    = round(quantile(age_model, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    q90_age    = round(quantile(age_model, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    mean_amh   = round(mean(amh, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd_amh     = round(sd(amh,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    q10_amh    = round(quantile(amh, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    q90_amh    = round(quantile(amh, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    mean_afc   = round(mean(afc, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd_afc     = round(sd(afc,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    q10_afc    = round(quantile(afc, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    q90_afc    = round(quantile(afc, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(lb_split_compare, caption = "Train vs validation summary")
```


```{r std_diff}
std_diff <- lb_split_compare %>%
  summarize(
    age = round((mean_age[val_flag == "val"] - mean_age[val_flag == "train"]) /
                  sd_age[val_flag == "train"], 3),
    amh = round((mean_amh[val_flag == "val"] - mean_amh[val_flag == "train"]) /
                  sd_amh[val_flag == "train"], 3),
    afc = round((mean_afc[val_flag == "val"] - mean_afc[val_flag == "train"]) /
                  sd_afc[val_flag == "train"], 3)
  )

kable(std_diff, caption = "Standardized mean difference (val - train)")
```
